to.description: `closing` is NOT terminal: it means "I am releasing this session". If another replica adopts it, it stays alive; if no one adopts it before the timeout, the drain sends `closed_abnormally`. `created` and `active` are left out because entering them is a decision made by the api, never by the engine reporting a termination.

reason.description: The ORIGIN of the termination, not a diagnosis by elimination.
